pitches.name: Maya
pitches.why: The client told me directly that Biscuit, the shop cat, sleeps in the window and is famous locally. A calm, curled-up sleeping cat suits the calm mood and should please them. The fox is only hearsay, and an owl is wise but has no personal link to the shop.

pitches.name: Tom
pitches.why: A curled-up cat feels calm, friendly and at rest, and its round shape with pointed ears is easy for blind judges to recognise in dominoes. It's cosy for a children's bookshop window, though an owl would be my second choice for 'wise'.

pitches.name: Priya
pitches.why: The regulars bring treats for the shop cat every day, so the client clearly loves that cat. A calmly sitting cat with pointed ears and a curled tail reads clearly in dominoes and fits the calm, wise feel. An owl would be my second choice if a teammate knows something against cats.

pitches.name: Leo
pitches.why: A tortoise feels calm and wise, fits a children's bookshop (slow, patient reading, storybook favourite), and avoids the owl the client wants to move away from. Its domed shell and four legs also make a recognisable silhouette in dominoes.
